Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase. The South African players make their way out into the middle. Lendl Simmons and Evin Lewis are the openers for West Indies. Bjorn Fortuin will begin with the ball.

Right then. The Proteas were at around 125 after 14 overs but the middle order was not able to take it to their advantage, as they ended up adding around 40 runs in six overs. The West Indies side needs to chase 169 runs to seal the series. Join us in a while for the chase in this series decider.

Aiden Markram joins for a chat. He says they have come a long way together, and they have good communication in the middle. Also says de Kock has been outstanding in this series. States that it has been difficult to bat on these pitches. Also says he is looking forward to seeing the new bowling pair perform and hopes it works in their favour.

It was Edwards who gave a dream start, as he took a wicket in his first spell to West Indies but they were not able to capitalize on it. The skipper tried various combinations with the bowlers, but they struggled to find a breakthrough. Until, Fidel Edwards was called back into the action in the 15th over, only to dismiss the main man, de Kock. Soon after, McCoy got his first wicket as he deceived Markram with a slower delivery. Gayle and Pollard were good with the ball but were not able to scalp any wickets. The debutant, Hosein, and Russell were expensive from the lot. Bravo also bowled well in the death overs to dismiss van der Dussen.

This has been a good comeback by the hosts! South Africa were running away with their batting, but the last 5 overs have been good for West Indies! Even after a poor start by the skipper Bavuma who got dismissed on a duck in his third ball, de Kock and Markram showed maturity as they stitched a really important partnership of over 125 runs. Soon, de Kock had to make his way back into the shed after knocking 60 runs. Later Markram found himself in the dugout, after scoring 70 runs. Also, van der Dussen failed to impress today. It was then Miller and Mulder to power the innings to 168.
On the body, short ball, pulled to deep square leg for one. SOUTH AFRICA FINISH ON 168/4!
On a fuller length, outside off, quicker ball too, Mulder swings hard but misses. The keeper collects and appeals but the umpire shakes his head.
Fuller outside off, this is squeezed to the right of the backward point fielder, who dives that side and stops the ball. A single.
FOUR! A full toss and this has gone for a boundary. Outside off, slapped over point for a four. Much needed!
In the air...safe! Around off, shortish, slower too, Mulder looks to pull but the ball goes high and lands near mid on. A single.
On a length outside off, hit hard to long on for a run.
Andre Russell comes to bowl the final over.
A short ball, down the leg side, Wiaan Mulder moves across and looks to pull this one but he misses. The batter thinks that this should be a wide, but the umpire does not agree. A legal ball, then!
EDGY FOUR! Not how they wanted this, but they will not care. A length ball, outside off, Mulder swings hard but the ball takes the inside edge and runs away to the fine leg fence.
A slower back of a length ball on off, pushed back towards McCoy.
Around middle, guided to point for one more. Just 3 runs off the first 3 balls of this over!
Outside off, hit hard to long off for one.
Around off, this is tapped to short third man for a quick single.
Fuller outside off, pushed to covers for one. Another top over by Bravo! 17 off the last 3 overs!
A yorker at the base of off, dug out to mid-wicket for one.
Fuller outside off, drilled to covers for a quick run.
Another slow ball on off, eased to long off for a single.
The next man in coming at No. 6 is Wiaan Mulder.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Outstanding stuff. Completely deceives the batter and Rassie goes back without troubling the bowlers. A slower length ball, around off. Rassie van der Dussen looks to work this one to the leg side but only manages to chip this one back towards DJ, who accepts gleefully.
Punched to the right of deep point for a single.
WIDE. Way outside off, left alone. Wide signalled.
Two good overs on the trot for the hosts, 5 runs and a wicket off this one! A slower yorker on off, this is jammed out to the on side, for a quick single.
A slower ball, on off, tapped to short third man for one.
On a length around off, drilled to long on for one.
Who will come in at No. 5? It is Rassie van der Dussen.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a big wicket and the slower ball has done the trick again. Markram played so well, but he has to head back. A slower ball, on middle, Aiden Markram looks to swing this one away but gets deceived by the slowness as the ball takes the upper part of the blade and lobs towards deep square leg. An easy catch for Lendl Simmons out there.
Commentary.Howout: c Lendl Simmons b Obed McCoy

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, angling on leg, Miller misses his flick and the ball takes the pad and goes to the off side for one. Leg bye given.
In the air...safe! On the bounce to the man there. Around off, length ball, chipped over mid off and just ahead of Pollard at long off. One run.
Obed McCoy comes into the attack now. He replaces Fidel Edwards.
A good over for West Indies after a while, only 6 off the over! Around off, pushed to covers for one more.
5 singles in a row as this is worked to long off.
Very well bowled. A slower length ball on middle, chipped towards mid on for a single.
On a fuller length outside off, driven to covers for a single.
A slower full toss on middle, eased through mid on for a single.
A slower length ball on off, pushed to covers for one.
On a length, outside off, Miller steers it to third man for another single.
On off, Markram drives it to cover for another single.
Serves a full length ball, on off, Miller works it to the right of mid off for a single.
A length ball, on off, Markram guides it to short third man for a single.
FOUR! Shot of authority! A length ball, on off, Aiden Markram leans in and creams it past the mid off fielder for a boundary.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fidel Edwards takes no time to strike again. He comes back into the attack and delivers yet again. A length ball, on off, de Kock gets low and looks to power it over the long on fence for a biggie, but fails to get any distance on it. Andre Russell in the deep does a very good job to dive in front of him and dismiss Quinton de Kock.
Commentary.Howout: c Andre Russell b Fidel Edwards

Commentary.Commentary: David Miller is the new man in.

Full and outside off, de Kock looks to flick it but manages to get an inside edge and takes off for a single. The keeper collect the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but misses by a mile. Aiden Markram is safe in the end.
Fidel Edwards comes back. 2-0-11-1 so far.
A full length ball, outside off, de Kock slashes it towards sweeper cover. Akeal Hosein covers enough ground to his right and keeps it down to just two.
Full and on off, Markram drives it down the ground. The ball hits the stumps at the other end and rolls to the mid off region. Single taken.
A single now. Full and outside off, de Kock works it again through the cover region. This time a fielder is present in the deep to cut it off.
FOUR! Nicely played. A full length delivery, on off, de Kock drives it through covers for a boundary.
BEATEN! A length ball, outside off, de Kock looks to heave it away but misses. The ball bounces over the blade.
Full and on the pads, de Kock clips it towards mid-wicket for a single. He keeps the strike. 7 runs off the over.
A length ball, on off, Markram pushes it through the cover region for a single.
BEATEN! Good length ball, outside off, swinging away a bit. Markman looks to go after it but misses.
Full and on middle. de Kock digs it out to the leg side for a single.
A length ball, on off, Markram pushes it to long off and gets a run.
WIDE! Full and outside off, Markram gets low and tries to reach out but misses. Wide given.
WIDE! Full and outside off, Markram looks to chase it but misses. Wided.
Full toss and on off, de Kock pulls it through mid-wicket for a single. This also brings up his FIFTY! How consistent has he been throughout this series. Absolutely brilliant.
Flatter again, outside off, Markram cuts it through point. This time the man in the deep was able to keep the ball out. Two taken.14 off the over!
Obed McCoy (1-0-13-0) is back!
FOUR! Finds the gap this time. Flatter and outside off, Aiden Markram stays back and cuts it through the point region for a boundary.
SIX! FIFTY FOR AIDEN MARKRAM! Gets it in style. Full and on off, Markram uses his feet and connects it well, well enough to clear the fence at long off for a maximum.
Floated on off, Markram drives it to cover.
On off, worked to the off side for a single. 100-RUN STAND COMES UP BETWEEN THESE TWO.

BYE! A shortish ball, on leg, Markram moves away to the leg side, showing all the stumps. The ball bounces off the track a bit high. Markram looks to swing his blade in hope but misses. The keeper also fails to collect the ball as it ends up at fine leg. A bye taken.
Akeal Hosein returns. 1-0-11-0 so far.
Serves a length ball, on off, Markram pushes it to the off side and takes a run to keep the strike. This has been a really good effort by the two batsmen. The stand moves to 98.
WIDE! Full and outside off, Markram leaves it alone. Wide called.
A length ball, on off, de Kock pushes it to long off and gets a single.
A full length ball, on off, de Kock defends it back to the bowler.
A length ball, outside off, Markram punches it through the cover region for a single.
SIX! He picked that one off the middle. A length ball, on off, Markram powers it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Full length ball, on the pads, de Kock tucks it to the leg side for a single.
A slower ball, outside off, pushed through covers for one. 10 off the 10th over, then!
Again, there is some good running between these two. A full toss, outside off, punched to deep covers for a couple.
FOUR! Well played. Very well played. Excellent placement from de Kock. A touch fuller, outside off, de Kock slaps this one through point and gets a boundary.
3 singles in a row as this is pushed through covers.
Another single as this is eased to long off.
Fuller on middle, eased through mid off for one.
Dwayne Bravo comes back into the attack. He replaces Chris Gayle. His figures 1-0-6-0 so far.
Full, around off, de Kock looks to punch, but gets an inside edge back onto the pads.
Well fielded by Akeal Hosein in the deep and he saves a couple for his team. A slower short ball, around off, pulled to the left of AK in the deep, who rushes and stops the ball. Two.
Good running by these two again. Fuller, outside off, punched through covers for a couple.
A slower short ball around off, hooked to deep mid-wicket for one.
On middle, nudged to the on side for one.

NOT OUT! Quinton de Kock was sure that there was no bat and the review saves him here. On a length, angling away from the southpaw, de Kock looks to punch this one through the off side but he misses and there is a sound as the ball goes to the keeper, who collects and appeals. A loud appeal and the umpire takes his time, but then raises his finger. De Kock goes for the review straightaway and it works out for him, as Ultra Edge shows a flatline throughout. The on-field decision is reversed.

Review time! Quinton de Kock takes the review for caught behind. The on field decision is OUT. The Ultra Edge shows a flat line as the ball passed the bat. The decision is overturned. Also the Porteas don't lose a review here.
Change. The skipper, Kieron Pollard has introduced himself into the attack.
SIX! That was as clean as a whistle. Gayle tosses this up and lands it around off, Aiden Markram lofts this one over wide long on for a biggie.

In the air...safe! Falls just short of the West Indies skipper there. Around off, floated, full too, de Kock chips this one over mid off. KP comes ahead, but it lands ahead of him, a single, in the end.
Full and floated outside off, jammed out to mid off for one.
Around off, defended back towards Chris.
Loopy around off, nudged to the right of short fine leg for one.
Around off, punched to covers for one.
WIDE. This is slipped down the leg side, AM misses his flick and the keeper collects and whips the bails off. An appeal but turned down. Wide signalled.
Chris Gayle is back into the attack now. He replaces Andre Russell.
11 off his first over! Floated, around leg, Aiden skips down the track and works this through mid on for a single.
A couple now as Markram goes back and punches this one to the left of long off.
A touch short around off, this is dabbed late to the short third man fielder for one.
Shortish and this is darted around leg, de Kock looks to pull but misses.
SIX! De Kock is putting the debutant under pressure very early on. Tossed up, around off, this is slogged away to the deep mid-wicket region.
Flatter around off, AM goes back and punches this one to deep covers. Brings up the 50-run stand between these two.
Akeal Hosein comes into the attack now, replaces Obed McCoy.
SWING AND A MISS. A short ball, very short actually. Outside off, de Kock looks to pull but misses. 15 off the over, nonetheless. South Africa are at 49/1 at the end of the Powerplay.
On a fuller length outside off, pushed towards mid off.
FOUR! Down the ground with a lot of power. 14 off the last 3 balls. Around off, fuller in length, this is drilled over mid on for a boundary.
SIX! DISPATCHED! That sounded so good, off the bat. A full toss around off, Quinton de Kock smokes this one all the way over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
FOUR! Slight bit of risk but it works out. A length ball, outside off, this is sliced over the backward point region for a boundary.
Around off, pushed gently to the mid off region for a single.
Full toss and on off, de Kock could not take an advantage, as he works it to mid-wicket. They take a couple. De Kock had to put in a diving effort in the end to keep himself in.
Andre Russell to bowl now.
Full, on middle, de Kock flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a couple. Good running.
On off, pushed to cover for a single.
Full and outside off, de Kock taps it to point and rotates the strike.

A length ball, on off, Markram pushes it to mid off and takes off for a single. Bravo collects the ball neatly and has a shy at the bowler's end. The ball zips past the stumps, as Aiden Markram gets into the crease. Had DJ struck, Aiden would have to run all the way to the shed.
SIX! BANG! McCoy gets punished in his first delivery. A full length ball, on off, Markram powers it over the long off fence for a maximum.
Change. Obed McCoy has the ball in hand now.
Full and on off, Aiden Markram works it to long on for another single. Moves to 13.
A length ball, outside off, de Kock looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the body. The ball rolls to the off side. Single taken.
A full toss on middle, Bravo was going for the yorker here but clearly did not manage it. Markram defends it to mid off and takes a single.
A length ball, on off, Markram pushes it to cover.
A length ball, outside off, de Kock prods and drives it through the cover region but only for a single.
On off, de Kock dabs it to point.
WIDE AGAIN! Full and way outside off, Bravo does not want to serve it in his arc here. It is an easy leave for de Kock. Wide given.
WIDE! A loosener. Full and way outside off, de Kock isn't interested to chase it. Wide called.
Change in bowling. Dwayne Bravo is introduced into the attack.
A length ball, on middle, Markram defends it to mid-wicket.
A length ball, on off, Markram works it to the leg side for a couple.
FOUR! Worked it fine. Nicely played. Full and on the pads. Markram tucks it fine, fine enough as the ball ends up in the boundary in a flash, at fine leg. Edwards isn't happy as he kicks the ground.
BEATEN! Back of a length ball, on off, Markram looks to hook it away but misses. The ball ends up with the keeper.
A length ball, on the pads, Markram flicks it over the mid-wicket region for a couple.
An inswinger, full and on off, Markram drives it down the ground. Edwards makes a brilliant stop, with less time to react.
On off, de Kock works it to cover. A tidy over by Chris Gayle.
On middle, Markram drives it to mid on for a single.
Floated on off, Markram plays it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, on middle, de Kock clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
On off, pushed to cover.
Flighted on off, de Kock pushes it to mid on. The man puts a diving effort to stop the ball but only helps it towards long off, a couple taken.
Back of a length ball, on off, Markram blocks it to cover. A great over by Fidel Edwards.
A length ball, on middle, Markram flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple. First runs off the bat now, as Aiden Markram gets off the mark.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is the Universe Boss, Chris Gayle!
A full length ball, on off, Markram defends it to cover.
WIDE! A full length ball, down the leg, Markram misses his flick. Wide called.

OUT! CAUGHT AT SLIPS! Two dots followed by a wicket, this is a dream start for Fidel Edwards and West Indies. Serves a length ball, on off, this time. Making the batsman play at it. Bavuma exactly does that. He looks to defend it but the ball takes the outside edge and goes towards the man at first slip. Chris Gayle is ready and takes a sharp low catch to dismiss the Saffa skipper for a 3-ball duck.
Commentary.Howout: c Chris Gayle b Fidel Edwards

Commentary.Commentary: The South African skipper walks back for a duck. Who replaces him? It will be Aiden Markram!
Follows it with a sharp bouncer around middle, Bavuma ducks under it.
Starts with a length ball, around the hips, Bavuma tucks it to mid-wicket.

Right then. Done with all the pre-match formalities as the action is all set to begin. But before that, the players take a knee to show their support for the 'Black Lives Matter' movement. Temba Bavuma and Quinton de Kock are the openers for South Africa. Fidel Edwards to begin with the ball. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Mike Haysman is in for the pitch report. He says that the whole square is nice and dry and the deck is looking good too. Opines that the track will slow up and it will assist the spinners again.

Roddy Estwick, the assistant coach of West Indies, says that both teams have bowled well. Feels that they both are looking at their best team combinations and they are looking to improve in the middle overs. Opines that it has got to be a team effort and the younger players need to make a contribution as well. Says that they have tried to give everybody an opportunity and they will look to tick all the boxes.

The South African coach, Mark Boucher is up for a chat. Says that it's been a close one, looking at the World Cup ahead the conditions are going to be very similar. Adds that they have enjoyed the series throughout. Also says a pattern that has formed and the middle and lower order have been off the strap. Ends by saying that they still haven't had a perfect game, hope that they see one today.

Kieron Pollard, the West Indian skipper, says that they will play the situation and they struggled with spin but feels that the guys have the mental fortitude to deal with it. States that they have one change as Hosein comes in and replaces Allen.

The South African skipper, Temba Bavuma says that they will bat first. The wicket looks on the dry side, so they will look to bat on this dry pitch. Also adds, it a privilege to captain this side. The players are looking up to the game and they will give it their all to end the series on a high note. States that they have two changes to their team as Mulder and Fortuin make their way in the team, replacing Hendricks and Nortje.

West Indies (PLAYING XI) -  Lendl Simmons, Evin Lewis, Chris Gayle, Shimron Hetmyer, Nicholas Pooran (WK), Kieron Pollard (C), Andre Russell, Dwayne Bravo, Akeal Hosein (IN PLACE OF Fabian Allen), Obed McCoy, Fidel Edwards.

South Africa (PLAYING XI) -  Quinton de Kock (WK), Aiden Markram, Temba Bavuma (C), Rassie van der Dussen, David Miller, Wiaan Mulder (IN PLACE OF Beuran Hendricks), George Linde, Kagiso Rabada, Tabraiz Shamsi, Bjorn Fortuin (IN PLACE OF Anrich Nortje), Lungi Ngidi.
TOSS - The coin goes up and it lands in the favour of South Africa. They opt to bat first.

Well, it is series decider time! After 4 well-fought contests between West Indies and South Africa, the series is well poised at 2-2 and the winner of this clash will take home the trophy too. West Indies have the backing of the home crowd and also momentum with them, but the Proteas have shown time and time again, on this tour, that they are no pushovers. It will be one last blast to the finish line. On that note, a warm welcome to the 5th and final T20I between these two sides. Toss and team news up in a bit.
